message:
test(viewer): T-P11d label says a fresh keyframe anchored at admit ends pending, not a decoded keyframe

Wording only, no behaviour change. Under the S13 rule (1005ebe) decoding a frame never ends
resumeAnchorPending; the keyframe in T-P11d is fresh (1 ms hold) and ends pending because admit
anchors on it. The printf and the two comments said "decoded keyframe", which described the old
c3c3d76 behaviour. Requested by the verifying Claude (t-5ahw0t5x, seq 1114 item 3).
history #409 addendum.
